definitions.explanation: What can be seen from a particular location; the visual scene that spreads before one's eyes.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}からの{眺|なが}めは{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: The view from this room is the best.

examples.japanese: {山頂|さんちょう}からの{眺|なが}めを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We enjoyed the view from the mountain top.

examples.japanese: {眺|なが}めのいいレストランを{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I made a reservation at a restaurant with a nice view.
examples.notes: 眺めのいい = with a good view

notes:
USAGE: {眺|なが}め is the noun form of the verb {眺|なが}める (to gaze at, to look out over). It emphasizes the visual experience of looking at scenery from a vantage point.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{眺|なが}めがいい (has a good view)
・{眺|なが}めを{楽|たの}しむ (to enjoy the view)
・〜からの{眺|なが}め (the view from ~)
・{眺|なが}めのいい{部屋|へや} (room with a view)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{景色|けしき} - scenery, landscape (general)
・{風景|ふうけい} - scenery, landscape (more formal/literary)
・{光景|こうけい} - scene, sight (can include events)
・{展望|てんぼう} - outlook, view (often from observation points)
